title: Psychiatric Stays – Aftercare Through App
summary: Returning to daily life after discharge from child and adolescent psychiatry is associated with multiple psychological, social, and academic challenges for children, adolescents, and their parents and teachers. The PANDA project aims to examine and facilitate this reintegration following discharge. It supports the transition period with an app, a phone call, and an aftercare appointment. In the app, all participants have the opportunity during the first three months after discharge to answer questions about reintegration, document successes in a positive diary, and, if necessary, contact the clinic via a messenger service or the emergency number. Two weeks after discharge, a phone call takes place with the families to discuss the current situation and concerns for the aftercare appointment. Data collected in the app and during the phone call is made available to the case therapists so that aftercare appointments can be effectively prepared and utilized, and relevant concerns discussed. With the families’ consent, teachers can also participate in the project and receive support. Teachers complete a one-time survey in the app regarding school reintegration and are also provided with the contact options via the messenger service and the emergency number. If necessary, a phone call takes place between the clinic and the teacher. In addition, the app provides teachers with a handbook containing information on mental disorders in the school environment.
conditions: Inpatients with a psychiatric F-code diagnosis according to ICD-10, aged 6–18 years

interventions.name: After giving informed consent for participation in the study, children and adolescents following partial or full inpatient psychiatric hospitalization, as well as their parents and teachers, receive a digitally supported aftercare service (app up to 3 months after discharge, 1 phone call of 20–30 mi

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Partial or full inpatient treatment of the child or adolescent in the department
- Sufficient German language skills of each participant
- Written informed consent of each participant
Exclusion criteria:
- Insufficient German language skills of a participant
- Readmission of the child or adolescent > 1 week during the intervention
